subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After resolving the dirty merge state, should the exact dependency move plus shared QA runner and Gateway admission changes land with this Matrix migration, or should the generic changes be split for separate ownership review?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but dependency authorization and the permanent owner boundaries of the shared QA and Gateway changes require maintainer intent that automated review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Resolve and approve together
options.body: Resolve conflicts, re-prove the exact result, authorize its dependency graph, and merge the stack if the relevant owners accept the coupled generic changes.

options.title: Split generic changes
options.body: Move the shared QA runner and Gateway admission changes into separately reviewed PRs before landing the Matrix scenario migration.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep the PR open without dependency authorization until maintainers reconsider the migration boundary.

recommendation.title: Resolve and approve together
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, re-prove the exact result, authorize its dependency graph, and merge the stack if the relevant owners accept the coupled generic changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active migration stack and are best positioned to coordinate conflict resolution and the required cross-owner approvals.
